1. Startable with $0-500 ACTUAL capital (not theory)

4. Focused on SMALL niches (not broad markets)
5. Have CALCULATION thinking (unit economics, margin math)

- Specific niche name (not category)
- Day 1 action (what to do with $0-500)

- Cash conversion cycle: days from action to cash

- Lindy score (how old is this business model type?)
- Kill criterion (when to abandon)
- Scaling path ($2K → $10K → $50K/mo)

Target: 10-12 models with full calculation detail.
